final: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), fractions AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, 1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_fraction FROM counts) SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, fraction - average_fraction AS excess FROM fractions WHERE fraction > average_fraction ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
